name: Cloudflare Turnstile Free
free_limit: Up to 20 free Turnstile widgets/account; 10 configured hostnames/widget and unlimited verification challenges
watch_out: Turnstile Free can protect production websites, including small and medium businesses, independently of other Cloudflare services. Analytics lookback is limited to 7 days. Custom-branding removal, any-hostname widgets and ephemeral IDs are Enterprise-only; Free supports pre-clearance.
